name: claudecomplete
description: Inline code completions and AI edit suggestions powered by the Claude API (or any OpenAI-compatible API).

enumDescriptions: Claude API via the official Anthropic SDK (supports prompt caching).
Any OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, OpenRouter, ...).
claudeComplete.provider.description: Which backend to use for completions and edits.

claudeComplete.anthropic.baseUrl.description: Optional base URL for the Claude API (proxy or gateway). Leave empty for the default.

claudeComplete.openai.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API (must contain the /v1 segment if the server expects it).

claudeComplete.completion.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens generated per inline completion.

claudeComplete.completion.effort.description: Reasoning effort for Claude models on completions (Anthropic provider only). Lower is faster and cheaper.

claudeComplete.completion.debounceMs.description: Wait this long after the last keystroke before requesting a completion.

claudeComplete.completion.multiline.description: Allow multi-line completions. 'auto' allows them only when the cursor is at the end of a line.

claudeComplete.completion.contextLinesBe.description: Lines before the cursor sent as the live prefix (the volatile part of the prompt).

claudeComplete.completion.contextLinesAf.description: Lines after the cursor sent as the live suffix.

claudeComplete.completion.includeOpenTab.description: Include snippets from other open editors in the cached context snapshot.

claudeComplete.completion.systemPrompt.description: System prompt for inline completions. Leave empty to use the built-in default (see README).

claudeComplete.completion.promptTemplate.description: Prompt template for inline completions. Placeholders: {prefix}, {suffix}, {language}, {filename}. Leave empty to use the built-in default.

claudeComplete.edit.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens generated per edit suggestion.

claudeComplete.edit.effort.description: Reasoning effort for Claude models on edits (Anthropic provider only).

enumDescriptions: Use VS Code's native inline-edit UI (floating diff, gutter menu - the Copilot look) when the 'inlineCompletionsAdditions' API proposal is enabled for this extension, otherwise fall back to in-editor decorations.
Always use the native inline-edit UI (requires the API proposal, see README).
Always render the suggestion with decorations: changed words highlighted in place, new lines green, gutter marker with Accept/Reject hover menu.
claudeComplete.edit.presentation.markdownDescription: How edit suggestions are presented. The native UI needs `--enable-proposed-api chibisuke.claudecomplete` or `"enable-proposed-api": ["chibisuke.claudecomplete"]` in `argv.json` (see README).

claudeComplete.edit.systemPrompt.description: System prompt for edit suggestions. Leave empty to use the built-in default.

claudeComplete.edit.promptTemplate.description: Prompt template for edit suggestions. Placeholders: {selection}, {instruction}, {language}, {filename}, {before}, {after}. Leave empty to use the built-in default.

claudeComplete.disabledLanguages.description: Language IDs for which inline completions are disabled.

claudeComplete.cache.enabled.description: Use Claude prompt caching: system prompt and context snapshot are sent as a stable, cached prefix.

claudeComplete.cache.systemPromptTtl.description: Cache TTL for the system prompt block. 1h costs more to write but survives longer pauses.

claudeComplete.cache.prewarm.description: Write the cache (max_tokens: 0 request) as soon as a new context snapshot is created, so the first completion is already a cache hit.

claudeComplete.cache.keepAlive.description: Refresh the cache shortly before it expires while an editor is focused, even without typing. Costs a cache read per refresh.

claudeComplete.cache.snapshotMaxChars.description: Maximum size (characters) of the context snapshot. Large files are trimmed around the cursor, keeping the file head.

claudeComplete.cache.snapshotRefreshLine.description: Refresh the snapshot once the document line count has drifted this far from the snapshot, or on save / file switch.

claudeComplete.cache.snapshotMaxAgeSec.description: Refresh the snapshot after this many seconds at the latest.

claudeComplete.logPrompts.description: Log full prompts to the ClaudeComplete output channel (may contain source code).

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && tsc -p test/e2e/tsconfig.json && node ./out/test/e2e/runTests.js
